title: All alerts currently disabled
body:
Hi all,

It's been a week now i am trying to fix this issue.  There is a message in the upper left corner of Xdrip plus app saying: ''All alertes currently disabled''.  
So there is no alerts at all, neither for high or low glucose level.
I tried uninstalling and re-installing the application -- nothing happened

Could someone tell me how to re-enable the alerts?

Thank you very much!!!
![screenshot_20190308-105057_xdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36271953/54039514-1f239600-4191-11e9-902d-114b94b85b81.jpg)

comments.body:
Hi @JayBouch1977. I was able to reproduce the screenshot. The problem is that you've selected to snooze all alerts somehow. Here are the steps to reactivate the alerts:
1. Menu > Snooze Alert 
1. Select `Re-Enable All Alerts`

Hope this helps!

This issue can now be closed @jamorham.

@JayBouch1977 Would you please close this issue if the problem has been resolved?
Thanks
